articles.title: Chael Reacts to Gable Steveson’s KO Loss
articles.description: Visit http://bearmattress.com/chael and use my CODE: chael to get 40% off your Bear mattress! Thank you to Bear Mattress for sponsoring! The reaction to Gable Steveson’s loss tells Chael Sonnen a lot about how long someone has been watching combat sports. One loss does not mean Gable is finished. History is filled with elite fighters who suffered setbacks and came back better. For Chael, the more interesting question is what Gable should take from the experience. Gable entered MMA as one of the hottest prospects the sport has ever seen, with an elite wrestling résumé and expectations unlike almost anyone before him. But there’s a trap that great wrestlers can fall into when transitioning to MMA: believing they need to prove how well-rounded they’ve become. Chael argues they don’t. Your best weapon should remain your priority. Close the distance. Get your hands on your opponent. Put him against the fence. Take him down. If he gets back up, do it again. The striking, submissions, and other skills are there when you need them, but you don’t need to showcase everything you learned in the gym. Sometimes the lesson is much simpler: do what made you great. articles.title: What Exactly Is Ciryl Gane Right Now?
articles.description: Tom Aspinall has vacated the UFC heavyweight championship, but somehow Ciryl Gane isn't automatically the undisputed champion. So what exactly is he? Gane won the interim heavyweight championship for a reason. Historically, when the undisputed champion is no longer available, the interim champion is there to keep the division moving. But if Gane now fights Josh Hokit for the vacant undisputed championship, what happens to the interim belt he already owns? Chael Sonnen breaks down the strange logic surrounding the UFC heavyweight title picture, why Gane's current status raises more questions than answers, and whether it's even possible for an interim champion to compete for another belt without putting his own championship on the line. Whatever you've got in this sport is usually on the line. So if Ciryl Gane isn't the undisputed champion, and his interim championship isn't being defended, what exactly happened to it? articles.title: Joshua Van vs Alexandre Pantoja 2 #ufc
articles.description: Was Joshua Van’s win over Alexandre Pantoja really a fluke? Chael Sonnen breaks down the story surrounding a potential Pantoja vs. Van rematch—and why the timing could matter just as much as the result. Pantoja has reportedly grown frustrated with the idea of Joshua Van calling himself champion, but Van has taken a very different approach, openly acknowledging that he believes he needs to beat Pantoja again for it to truly mean something. That sets up a fascinating question: who was actually better that night? Chael also examines the biggest variable heading into another fight—the injury Pantoja suffered and how long he has had to recover. If Pantoja only returned to training relatively recently, could that affect how prepared he is when the rematch finally happens? The first fight may be history, but the rematch could settle the argument once and for all. #UFC #MMA #JoshuaVan #AlexandrePantoja #Pantoja #ChaelSonnen #UFCFlyweight #UFCNews #UFCChampionship

articles.title: Arman Tsarukyan Is Becoming Impossible to Ignore #ufc
articles.description: Is Arman Tsarukyan quietly becoming one of the biggest stars in MMA? Chael Sonnen breaks down why Arman has suddenly become impossible to ignore. He’s ranked No. 1, he doesn’t currently have an MMA fight booked, his food-review content is exploding, and he’s still finding ways to stay in the spotlight—including a newly announced matchup with Uriah Faber. But the real question is whether Tsarukyan has the potential to become the UFC’s next major superstar. Chael points to Arman’s performance against Charles Oliveira and the level of competition he has already handled as evidence that the talent is there. He also compares Arman’s rise with the other names being discussed as the next face of the UFC, including Ilia Topuria, Islam Makhachev and Paddy Pimblett. With Conor McGregor absent from the UFC spotlight, who fills that void? Chael thinks Arman Tsarukyan may already be much more interesting than people realize. #UFC #MMA #ArmanTsarukyan #ChaelSonnen #UFCNews #UFCStar #IslamMakhachev #IliaTopuria #PaddyPimblett
